technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt Spring Integration extension patterns for each source/sink module to ensure consistency with the reference implementations (spring-integration-websocket, spring-integration-aws).
Implement each source/sink as a standalone Maven module under a multi-module project to allow independent versioning and reuse.
Use Spring Boot auto-configuration mechanism to wire modules into the runtime and minimize boilerplate for end users.
Leverage existing official AWS SDK v2 (S3, SES), DataStax Cassandra Java driver, SOLRJ client, and HAWQ PXF client libraries rather than building custom protocols.
For the HAWQ sink, use Avro/Parquet serialization through PXF with a configurable schema registry approach.
Model the Error Channel feature as a dedicated publish-subscribe channel integrated with the existing global error channel abstraction, supporting configurable exception-type filters.
Build exception hierarchy (GlobalException, DefaultException, ModuleSpecificException) as runtime-extensible types so that the 'Caused by' chain is preserved when staging exceptions as payloads.
Treat U8 (data partition strategy) as test-coverage and regression work only, since the functionality is already part of the GA release.
Include unit tests in the effort estimate for each module; integration tests are aggregated as a separate cross-module activity.
Use Java 17+ as the baseline (per Spring Framework 6.0 requirement).
assumptions: A single experienced Java/Spring developer performs all the work.
A workday equals 8 productive hours (no meetings/admin time included in estimates).
Reference Spring Integration extensions (websocket, aws) are publicly available and can be used as implementation references, reducing the discovery and prototyping effort.

External test infrastructure (AWS sandbox, Cassandra cluster, SOLR server, HAWQ+PXF endpoint) is already provisioned; if not, an additional ~2 workdays per module would be required (not included here).
Module-specific unit tests are scoped within each module's effort estimate; only cross-module end-to-end integration tests are estimated separately.
Existing data partition strategy implementation in the GA release is stable and only needs targeted regression tests for add/delete module scenarios.
Documentation means module-level README and JavaDoc; a separate user guide is not in scope.
No migration, performance tuning, or production hardening beyond standard best practices is included.

activities.activity_description: Create multi-module Maven project layout, parent POM, shared dependencies, CI-friendly module skeletons, and baseline configuration (Spring Boot starters, Java 17 toolchain, checkstyle, test scaffolding).
Implement a WebSocket source adapter with message channel binding, sub-protocol support, and lifecycle management, based on spring-integration-websocket patterns. Includes unit tests.
Implement S3 object ingestion source (poll/event-based) and SES inbound email source using the AWS SDK v2. Includes configurable credentials, region, and unit tests.
Implement a Cassandra sink adapter using the DataStax Java driver supporting prepared statements, batching, and configurable consistency level for high-velocity writes. Includes unit tests.
Implement an S3 sink adapter supporting direct write, multipart upload, configurable key strategies, and content-type detection. Includes unit tests.

Implement a HAWQ sink that writes through PXF using Avro and Parquet formats. Includes external table mapping, schema handling, serialization, and unit tests. Most complex module due to format/transport combinations.
Implement a SOLR sink using SOLRJ supporting document conversion, commit/soft-commit strategies, and collection routing. Includes unit tests.

Implement configurable dedicated error channels (e.g., topic.errors.stream.module), the exception hierarchy (GlobalException, DefaultException, ModuleSpecificException), preservation of 'Caused by' chains, and routing logic for failures originating in any source/processor/sink. Includes unit tests.
Add automated regression tests covering add/delete module scenarios to verify that the data partition strategy dynamically adapts and state is preserved.

Design and execute end-to-end integration test scenarios combining multiple sources, the error channel feature, and various sinks (including failure-path scenarios) using embedded/test containers where applicable.
Write module-level READMEs, configuration property reference, JavaDoc, and example YAML configurations covering all new modules and the error channel feature.
Self-review for design consistency across modules, minor refactoring for shared abstractions, dependency upgrades, and final cleanup before release.
